note: Twenty-three fired rules reduce to three root nodes. The genome loaded the cardiometabolic dice (RC-1); chronic under-recovery is pulling the trigger (RC-2); early insulin resistance / ectopic fat is the modifiable hinge between them (RC-3). Blood, DNA, and wearable corroborate each other at every node.

root_nodes.name: Cardiometabolic genetic load (APOE ε4 + Lp(a) + 9p21 + TCF7L2)
root_nodes.intake_resolution: Father's MI at 58 + maternal T2D make this concrete, not theoretical. The genome can't be changed; its expression — ApoB — can be driven down hard.
attack_via: ApoB target <70 (tightened by ApoE ε4): Zone-2 cardio, soluble fiber, saturated→unsaturated fat swap, omega-3
Physician/lipidology referral: aggressive-lipid discussion + (SLCO1B1-informed) statin decision + first-degree Lp(a) family screening
Offer a genetic-counseling conversation for the APOE result

root_nodes.name: Chronic under-recovery / HPA activation
root_nodes.intake_resolution: Founder in a fundraise: ~6h sleep, phone in bed, 4 coffees (2 late) on a CYP1A2 slow background, no Zone-2, frequent red-eyes. The Whoop shows the autonomic cost in real time.
attack_via: Protect sleep (fixed wake, screens out of bed, wind-down) → the single highest-leverage lever
Caffeine cutoff 10:00 (CYP1A2 slow) — protects deep sleep + next-day HRV
Zone-2 base + one true recovery day; daily breathwork (COMT-matched down-regulation)

root_nodes.name: Early insulin resistance / ectopic (visceral + hepatic) fat
root_nodes.intake_resolution: Sedentary (ACWR 0.58, ~5k steps), refined-carb-heavy ordered-in meals, late dinners, weekly alcohol. The TCF7L2 variant lowers his secretory reserve, so this matters more for him than for the average 40-year-old.
attack_via: Zone-2 + resistance training (muscle = glucose sink); raise VO2max off the floor
Protein-forward, soluble-fiber, lower-glycemic meals that survive travel; cut the late dessert/alcohol
Visceral-fat loss is the common denominator that also lowers ApoB, TG, NAFLD, and raises HDL + T

methylation_overlay.name: MTHFR C677T + elevated homocysteine
methylation_overlay.note: Not a root node — a targeted supplement switch. Homocysteine 12.5 on a CT background → methylfolate + methyl-B12 instead of folic acid.

leaves_watch_not_chase: uric_acid 6.9 — follows the metabolic work; no urate drug unless gout/clinical
testosterone 420 — downstream of RC-2/RC-3; do NOT jump to TRT, fix the roots first
